lines: The first snow fell on the front last night. By dawn the wire was white.
Eighty-eight fell today. Thirty-nine Hegemony, forty-nine Concord.
The Grey Mill gun hit eleven Concord men. With forty-six wounded on stretchers, Concord medics reached only three in four.
Jakub You was killed on watch. His rifle was still on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from.
Five soldiers bought War Bonds today. The front stands in their debt.
The race for the Bone Quarry is close. Concord sixty-one, Hegemony fifty-nine.
Before winter, the wire must be mended. The Hegemony wire is torn in twenty-seven places.
Tonight the wiring parties go out.
Ninety-eight new soldiers came up the line yesterday.
Two thousand and ninety-seven now hold the front.
One thousand one hundred and thirty-one Concord.
Comment WIRE and your soldier crawls out tonight. New here? Comment HEGEMONY or CONCORD.
